title: 6DoF Animation
text: Create 3-D MATLAB Graphics animation of six-degrees-of-freedom object, 2 inputs, {Enter view} sets Entrance view Fixed; {Axes limits [xmin xmax ymin ymax zmin zmax]} sets the axes limits, {Time interval between updates}, {Size of craft displayed} scales factor, {Static object position [xp yp zp]} sets the static object position, {Position of camera [xc yc zc]} sets the camera position, {View angle} and {Enable animation} displays animation. Values come from the instance.
